transcript.speaker: advisor
transcript.text: Haanji Rajesh ji, FitNova se Arjun baat kar raha hoon. Aapne hamare weight management program ke liye inquiry submit ki thi?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Haan Arjun, mujhe muscle gain aur belly fat reduce karna hai. Subah office ke wajha se gym jaane ka time nahi milta.

transcript.speaker: advisor
transcript.text: Sahi baat hai sir. Hamare 12-week online coaching mein personal trainer app ke zariye daily home workout plan send karega. Kya aap 45 minutes daily de sakte hain?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Haan, 45 mins evening mein de sakta hoon. Nutrition plan mein Indian vegetarian meal options honge na?

transcript.speaker: advisor
transcript.text: Bilkul sir! High-protein vegetarian diet chart include hoga with paneer, sprouts, aur whey options. Monthly fee rupees three thousand nine hundred ninety nine hai.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Perfect, kal subah 11 baje demo trial book kar do.

transcript.speaker: advisor
transcript.text: Ji Rajesh ji, Sunday 11 AM demo session confirm kar diya hai. WhatsApp pe details share kar raha hoon.
